cardDesc: Five days in the jungle outside Tulum: a full transformative immersion in medicine ceremony, breath, and integration. Not a vacation, a reverent container for those seeking something more for their lives.
body: This is more than a retreat or vacation. It is five intentional days to disconnect from everyday distractions and fully focus on yourself, the medicine, and your experience.

pricing.title: Retreat pricing
pricing.note: Early bird pricing is available during the month of October only. Reserve your spot in October to receive $500 off the regular price. An $800 non-refundable deposit reserves your spot and is applied to your overall retreat cost. Payment plans are available and the remaining balance is due in full no later than one week before the retreat begins.

features.title: Location
features.text: A private retreat property in the jungle outside of Tulum, Mexico, with an on-site private cenote, fire pit, and private chef. Our group has the space entirely to ourselves for the duration of the experience.

features.title: Dates and arrival
features.text: April 1 to 5. Five days and four nights. Plan to arrive before 2pm at Tulum Airport on April 1st.

features.title: The medicine
features.text: One Kambo ceremony and three Bufo ceremonies, held with reverence alongside trained practitioners, paired with daily breathwork, workshops, and daily integration. Bufo is from Mexico so the connection to the medicine is much different here.

features.title: Who it is for
features.text: The Reverence Retreat is for high-functioning professionals, wisdom seekers, and those who know they are ready to find a new way to live. It is for people seeking deeper self-understanding, meaningful transformation, and a more intentional relationship with themselves and their lives. This retreat is co-ed and open to men and women 18+ who are ready for a full transformative immersion. Every participant completes a clarity call and screening process prior to acceptance.

intro:
The Reverence Retreat is for those who know they are ready to stop living in survival mode and begin living the lives they came here to live.

This is a deep, intentional retreat container built around reverence.

What is reverence?

Simply put, reverence means respect.

Respect for ourselves. 
Respect for each other.
Respect for the land that will hold us. 
And deep respect for the medicine we will have the opportunity to work with and integrate.

For five days, we step away from the chaos of everyday life and immerse ourselves in the space to truly slow down, reconnect, and intentionally meet ourselves through breathwork, medicine, ceremony, nature, and integration.

This is not a vacation or a recreational experience. 
It is an opportunity to give yourself the time, attention, and respect that your life deserves.

faq.a: Yes. This retreat is open to both men and women over the age of 18.

The retreat takes place at a private retreat property in the jungle outside of Tulum. Guests are transported to the property, and our group has the retreat space to ourselves for the duration of the experience.

faq.q: Can I attend if I am taking antidepressants or mood stabilizers?
faq.a: No. Participants must be off all mental health pharmaceutical medications to attend this retreat. Every participant also goes through our screening process prior to acceptance.

Guests can fly directly into Tulum International Airport. Cancun International Airport is also an option, as long as you arrange your own transportation to and from the retreat. You must arrive before 2pm on April 1st.
No. Airfare is not included in the retreat price. Guests are responsible for booking their own flights, and we recommend purchasing travel insurance.

faq.q: How do I reserve my spot?
faq.a: You must first book a retreat clarity call using the link below! An $800 non-refundable deposit is required to reserve your spot and is applied to the overall retreat cost.

faq.q: When is the remaining balance due?
faq.a: The remaining retreat balance must be paid in full no later than one week before the retreat begins. A payment plan will be discussed with the host, and pay in full discounts are also available.
